note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 Technical Manual TM 9-8012 for the Willys M38. Every value is grade documented and rests on the held manual. The manual publishes identity, the overall length, width and height, the wheelbase, the ground clearance, the net weight and the gross highway weight, the payload, the tyre size code, the engine model, the maximum allowable speed and the loaded cruising range.
